blurb: Trips take place aboard a 26’ Pursuit center console boat with twin 200 HP Suzuki engines. Guests fish for species like Striped Bass, Fluke, Bluefish, and offshore pelagics such as Wahoo and Bluefin Tuna. Captain Tom provides rods, reels, tackle, lures, and live bait, and allows alcohol except hard liquor on board.
